parent_protocol.inherited: training, kernel, optimizer, initialization, temperature sets, objectives, fit selection, search, confirmation, final fitting, failures; all unchanged

family.name: shared_squeezed_parity
family.encoder: P(t) [S(r)|+>^15 (x) |+>], P(t)=exp[-i (t/2) sum_{i<16} Z_i Z_16], S(r)=exp[i r (JyJz+JzJy)/15] on the 15 leaves; sin t = tanh(a beta^2), r = -kappa beta cos t; r=0 and t=a beta give the audited parity encoder at scale a
family.kappa_policy: fixed design constant from the development-only design pass, not searched (author decision 2026-10-13)
family.beta_scale_policy: beta_scale is the schedule constant a, searched log-uniformly on [0.3, 0.7]; it is not in the parity encoder's units, so the parent range does not apply
family.search_space: shared_parity learning_rate, init_scale, b1, one_minus_beta2, schedule and kernel_pair with the parent ranges and priors; beta_scale on beta_scale_range
family.ansatz: complete one- and two-body, 136 phases, no ancillas

randomness.fit_streams: parent namespace cw-parity-hpo-followup-20261009 and keys; target pools and fit streams pair with the audited shared_parity fits at every stage, repeat and start
randomness.sampler_keys: (sampler, shared_squeezed_parity, random|tpe) in the parent namespace; independent of the audited samplers

development_history: designed after the re-uploaded parity campaign (cw-reupload-hpo-20261013), whose final tied parity on J and doubled P
design pass used development temperatures only: exact capacity on (0.29, 0.65, 0.89, 1.25, 1.61, 1.975) and A-grid scoring; no F grid or marker temperatures
exact capacity, A grid: parity J 0.120 P 0.073; re-upload J 0.118 P 0.163; squeezed a=0.5 kappa=0.4 J 0.058 P 0.027
sampled run_fit, screen stage, audited shared_parity hyperparameters, 5 repeats: parity J 0.128 P 0.076; re-upload J 0.131 P 0.151; squeezed a=0.475 kappa=0.4 J 0.050 P 0.023
rejected alternatives: all-qubit squeezing, Gibbs qsample input, mean-field schedule, linear leaf squeeze
stages: random 60 -> author review -> TPE 60 -> author review -> confirmation (3-4 candidates, 5 repeats x 3 starts) -> author review -> final (10 repeats x 3 starts)
execution: fits may be sharded across machines with identical source identity; recording, Optuna ask/tell and selection run once on the primary workspace
